content: Fiye 5:1-32 Meeniŋ Adam’walaniŋ tububihila ulihakagiŋ diniŋ kahat.
Yoŋ adi Adam diniŋ yalakiŋiye ulihaka-talabugiŋ diniŋ youkudip. Bepaŋdi Adam tubumintaguk nai uŋaniŋ ne undiniŋgoŋ hinek tubumintaguk.
Adi adi maaniŋ eŋ taamuniŋ yehitubumintaaŋ meeniŋ yeniŋa kahaŋ tiyemguk.
Kaŋ Adam adi hatitalabulune guletŋiŋ 130 tulune mihiŋiŋ niŋ ne’walaŋ namandap agaŋ ne undiniŋgoŋ hinek mintaguk. Kaŋ wou Set youkuk.
Adam adi Set mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 800 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Adam adi unduŋ tiŋa hatitalogane guletŋiŋ 930 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Set adi guletŋiŋ 105 tulune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Enos mintaguk.
Set adi Enos mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 807 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Set adi unduŋ tiŋa hatitalogane guletŋiŋ 912 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Enos adi guletŋiŋ 90 tulune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Kenan mintaguk.
Enos adi Kenan mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 815 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Enos adi unduŋ tiŋa hatitalogane guletŋiŋ 905 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Kenan adi guletŋiŋ 70 tulune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Mahalale mintaguk.
Kenan adi Mahalale mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 840 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Kenan adi unduŋ tiŋa hatitalogane guletŋiŋ 910 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Mahalale adi guletŋiŋ 65 tulune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Yalet mintaguk.
Mahalale adi Yalet mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 830 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Mahalale adi unduŋ tiŋa hatigane guletŋiŋ 895 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Yalet adi guletŋiŋ 162 tulune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Inok mintaguk.
Yalet adi Inok mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 800 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Yalet adi unduŋ tiŋa hatigane guletŋiŋ 962 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Inok adi guletŋiŋ 65 tulune adi’walaniŋ mihiŋiŋ Metusela mintaguk.
Inok adi Bepaŋdut kifolok hinek tiŋa hatigumuk. Inok adi Metusela mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 300 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Inok adi unduŋ tiŋa hatilune guletŋiŋ 365 tuguk.
Adi Bepaŋdut kifolok hinek tiŋa hatigane liwe tuguk. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, adi Bepaŋ negoŋ nagikuk.
Metusela adi guletŋiŋ 187 tulune adi’walaniŋ mihiŋiŋ Lamek mintaguk.
Metusela adi Lamek mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula guletŋiŋ 782 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Metusela adi unduŋ tiŋa hati ulune gulet 969 tubune kumuŋguk.
Lamek adi guletŋiŋ 182 tulune adi’walaniŋ mihiŋiŋ niŋ mintaguk.
Mintaune indiŋ yoŋa wou Noa
youkuk, “Bepaŋ adi kwet haaki timiŋguk kaŋ folofigita kwanai tihatiyane mihi yendi nihitubukwelemawaak!”
Lamek adi Noa mintaguk uŋaniŋ tomboyoula gulet 595 hatilune wabiŋiŋ eŋ mihiŋiye noli maaŋ mintagiŋ.
Lamek adi unduŋ tiŋa hatigane guletŋiŋ 777 dapmaune kumuŋguk.
Noa adi gulet 500 hatilune adi’walaŋ mihiŋiye 3 mintamiŋgiŋ, wouhiye Sem, Ham eŋ Yafet.

footnotes.text: Noa mebi Hibulu mede gineŋ adi “niŋkulema”.
